description: Mention link types from a document-field class (supplier confirmation, packing slip, supplier invoice, freight bill, CoA, delivery receipt, customer PO, forwarder quote, AO packet, decision record) to the record types its text names that no other domain declared: sales invoices, sales orders, assembly orders, batches and batch schedules. A document reference whose target type had no declared link was counted undeclared_target and dropped (171,971 in the gen 11 build). Every link is a lead written by ontology/document_fields.py store_document_links.

link_types.name: for_assembly_order
link_types.description: A supplier confirmation names this AssemblyOrder: an identifier the one identifier grammar reads in its text, resolved through the identifier index (ontology/document_fields.py store_document_links). Always a lead: several candidates stay several links, and the document's author is unknown (an external assertion). Declared so the references counted undeclared_target by that step become links (AUD-13).
